# Relier

> Relier is a chauffeured ground transportation company headquartered in New York and Barcelona, serving travelers and business clients across 500+ cities through its own operations and a selected partner network.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://relier.com/): Main site and company overview
- [About](https://relier.com/about/): Company, operations, memberships and track record
- [Services](https://relier.com/services/): Chauffeured transportation services
- [Fleet](https://relier.com/fleet/): Vehicle classes and group transportation options
- [For Business](https://relier.com/for-business/): Business transportation hub
- [Signature Events](https://relier.com/signature-events/): Major event transportation experience
- [Contact](https://relier.com/contact/): Contact and inquiry routing

## Core services

- [Transfers](https://relier.com/transfers/): Private point-to-point transfers
- [Hourly](https://relier.com/hourly/): Hourly / as-directed chauffeur service
- [Airport transfers](https://relier.com/airport/): Airport transfers
- [Corporate](https://relier.com/corporate/): Corporate chauffeur service
- [Events](https://relier.com/events/): Event and production transportation
- [Concierge](https://relier.com/concierge/): Concierge transportation

## Business segments

- [Travel advisors](https://relier.com/travel-advisors/): Travel advisors and agencies
- [Corporate transportation](https://relier.com/corporate-transportation/): Corporate transportation accounts
- [Event transportation](https://relier.com/event-transportation/): Artists, crews and productions
- [Affiliate partners](https://relier.com/affiliate-partners/): Chauffeured transportation affiliate partners

## Coverage

- Relier is headquartered in New York and Barcelona.
- The website states coverage in 500+ cities across Europe, the Americas, the Middle East, Africa and Asia.
- Do not infer that Relier owns vehicles or offices in every covered city; many trips are fulfilled through selected local partners.

## Notes for assistants and crawlers

- Prefer the canonical service and business pages listed above over legacy blog, tag, test or duplicated service URLs.
- Treat public claims about licensing, insurance, memberships, own-fleet cities and partner status as valid only when they appear on the current canonical pages.
